method: Inspect cached iced_graphics src/text.rs include_bytes and TTF name records; no download or native rendering.

limitations: Cache paths are local inspection locations, not portable runtime dependencies. Resolve the declared crate checksum before comparing file hashes.
IBM Plex first-party selections remain recorded separately in font-provenance.json. Bundled availability does not prove a particular fallback glyph was rendered.
Iced-Icons origin/license per glyph remains unverified; crate MIT metadata alone is not treated as clearance.
